title: notifications plugin: per-site table, function, SES wiring and /api/notifications routes
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** A site turns notifications on in `papyrus.config.ts`. The Caducus package runs in the site's own stack. One switch, following `docs/plugins.md`; `amplify/plugins/newsletter/` is the model.

**Build.**
- `amplify/plugins/notifications/`: `papyrus.plugin.ts`, `config.ts` (site id, origin, base path, sending domain, from address and name, theme, lists with rules, `approval`). Add to `amplify/plugins/registry.ts`. Invalid settings stop the synth, as the newsletter's do.
- Stack: table retained, customer-managed KMS key, TTL, GSI `byRecipient`, no point-in-time recovery; create-only SecureString for the link key; router, email sender, flush and SES-event functions (Python, arm64), bundled through `pythonLambdaCode` with `caducus[notify]` at a pinned version beside `papyrus_content`; SQS with DLQs and an alarm on each DLQ; default-bus rule for this site's configuration set. Only the CMS role may invoke (a resource policy), as with the newsletter. Env carries `THEME_JSON`, names, kinds file.
- `papyrus_content/notifications/`: thin adapter passing `email_render` as the renderer.
- `app/api/notifications/{subscribe,confirm,preferences,unsubscribe,state}/route.ts`, modelled on `app/api/newsletter/*`: same-origin rule, 400 and 303 rather than 403 and 404, because the edge rewrites those to the site's 404. Invoke the site's function, no network API.
- No alarm listener per site: CloudWatch alarms go to the operator piece only.
- No GraphQL models with subscriptions; custom operations only, so no AppSync realtime.

**Acceptance.**
Synth tests; a site without the plugin answers 404 on the routes; the plugin adds a stack only where enabled.

**Depends on:** PPY-e82423
**Related:** kanbus-ff4727, kanbus-602759, kanbus-9cc7ec, PPY-c522bf

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Notifications plugin
  Scenario: Enabling it
    Given a site with the notifications plugin in its config
    When the site deploys
    Then its routes answer and its mail carries its own theme

  Scenario: A cross-site post
    When a subscribe post arrives from another origin
    Then it is refused with a 400 and nothing is sent

  Scenario: Sites do not share data
    Given two sites with the plugin
    When a reader subscribes on one
    Then the other site's table has no record of them
```

comments.text: Started in worktree Papyrus-worktrees/site-notifications (branch feat/site-notifications). Finding: caducus 0.2.0 only routes operator-class kinds to an SSM operator list; no public subscribe/confirm/preferences/consent yet, so the public routes ship as a pass-through that answers 'unavailable' until a Caducus release adds them.
